name: pine
description: Pine monorepo - issues and related services

scripts.dev:infra: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml up -d
scripts.dev:infra:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml down
scripts.dev:infra:observability: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml --profile observability up -d
scripts.dev:infra:observability:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml --profile observability down
scripts.dev:infra:multi-db: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.multi-db.yaml up -d
scripts.dev:infra:multi-db:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.multi-db.yaml down
scripts.dev:infra:multi-db:observability: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.multi-db.yaml --profile observability up -d
scripts.dev:infra:multi-db:observability:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.multi-db.yaml --profile observability down
scripts.dev:infra:single-db: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml up -d
scripts.dev:infra:single-db:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml down
scripts.dev:infra:single-db:observability: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml --profile observability up -d
scripts.dev:infra:single-db:observability:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/compose.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.single-db.yaml --profile observability down
scripts.gql:compose: rover supergraph compose --elv2-license accept --config supergraph-config-dev.yaml > services/gateway/supergraph.graphql
